verdict.rationale: Kick's docs show a double-entry ledger whose P&L updates in real time and whose P&L and Balance Sheet are organized by the Chart of Accounts. Financial statements can be pulled on demand via the CLI or MCP report generation, and locked periods keep reports accurate. However, no evidence names a cash-flow statement, and arbitrary-period selection is only implied. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented cash-flow statement, documented custom date-range or period selection for reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration of statement accuracy.
